slug: 反派手掌神女图我成了气运之女杀手
lines: 荒古中世界，合欢圣地。
一座金碧辉煌的宫殿内，一身穿鎏金长袍，面容俊美的青年猛地睁开双眼，看着周围熟悉又陌生的环境，眼中闪过一丝茫然。
“我这是穿越了？”
突然，一道如潮水般的记忆涌入他的脑海，过了一阵后，他终于理清了现状。
这一世和前世一样，都叫徐墨，且容貌也相同，胎穿十九载，直到今日，他才终于觉醒前世的记忆。
他所在的地方，是一个名为合欢圣地的势力，此势力就算放眼诸天万界，那也是排名前百的存在。
合欢圣地不仅底蕴深厚，强者无数，更重要的是，其中的大多数修士都是女修，且无一例外，大多精通合欢双修之法。
他更是合欢圣地的圣子，合欢宗当今圣主李暮雪唯一的儿子。
可是，他虽为合欢圣地圣子，但似乎直到现在都还没有尝过那**的滋味～
而作为穿越者，他自然也是有金手指的，而且还是两个。
第一个是一张散发金色光芒的图录。
这张图录上没有任何文字，上面全是人物虚影，但是隐约还是能看出全是女性，且目前只有前面一小部分能看清，后面还被粉色迷雾笼罩着。
第二个则是一本书，书身充满了岁月气息，看起来十分古老。
这本书里面的内容同样是空白的，甚至连书名都看不到，也不知道具体的作用是什么。
这两样东西东西都是他刚才觉醒记忆后突然出现在脑海中的。
咣当！
就在徐墨想进一步探索这两个金手指作用时，房门突然被人推开，将他的下一步的行动打断，徐墨微微皱眉，随即抬头望去。
只见房门处，站着一位身穿粉色衣裙的少女。
少女眉目如画，面容绝美，三千青丝飘拂，空气中隐有淡淡的清香，**着两只玉足上还各系着一颗翡翠铃铛，走起路来发出叮当叮当的声响。
“她是…”
看着面前的绝美少女，徐墨愣了下神。
“徐墨，你快把圣丹给我，我着急回去给叶哥哥疗伤。”
这时，少女冷冷的开口道，仿佛圣丹已是她的囊中之物般。
“叶哥哥？”
徐墨听到后，喃喃低语着，随后终于想起来了少女的身份。
面前的少女名为柳如烟，是合欢圣地的内门弟子，其容貌就算在偌大的合欢圣地，也能排进前三。
一年前，徐墨外出历练时遇到了外门弟子柳如烟，也因为她美丽的容貌，使得还未觉醒前世记忆的徐墨直接沦陷。
不仅将她破格提拔到了内门弟子，还将圣主每个月给他的修炼资源，全部上交给了柳如烟，妥妥的一只大舔狗。
最让徐墨感到离谱的是，这柳如烟还有一个青梅竹马名叫叶峰。
叶峰从小就经脉堵塞，不能修炼，身体更是每况日下。
柳如烟为了让叶峰活下来，竟每个月都来徐墨这，为叶峰讨要一颗圣丹，用来稳定病情，治疗堵塞的静脉。
而没觉醒前世记忆的徐墨，也不知道是哪根筋搭错了，竟真的给柳如烟圣丹了。
content_en:
The ancient world, the holy land of Hehuan.
In a splendid palace, a young man with a handsome face wearing a gilt robe suddenly opened his eyes, looking at the familiar and unfamiliar environment around him, a trace of confusion flashed in his eyes.
"Have I traveled through time?"
Suddenly, a flood of memories flooded into his mind. After a while, he finally understood the situation.
In this life, he was named Xu Mo and had the same appearance as in his previous life. He had been pregnant for nineteen years, and it was only today that he finally awakened to the memory of his previous life.
The place where he is is a force called Hehuan Holy Land. This force is one of the top 100 in the world.
Not only does the Holy Land of Acacia have a profound foundation and countless strong men, but more importantly, most of the monks there are female cultivators, and without exception, most of them are proficient in the dual cultivation of Acacia.
He is the Holy Son of Hehuan Holy Land and the only son of Li Muxue, the current Holy Master of Hehuan Sect.
However, even though he is the Holy Son of Hehuan Holy Land, it seems that he has never tasted the taste of sex until now~
As a time traveler, he naturally has golden fingers, and there are two of them.
The first is a picture album that glows golden.
There is no text on this catalog. It is full of shadows of people, but it can still be vaguely seen that they are all women, and currently only a small part of the front can be seen clearly, and the back is still shrouded in pink mist.
The second one is a book. The body of the book is full of time and looks very old.
The content in this book is also blank. You can't even see the title of the book, and you don't know what its specific function is.
These two things suddenly appeared in his mind after he awakened his memory just now.
Bang!
Just when Xu Mo wanted to further explore the role of these two golden fingers, the door was suddenly pushed open, interrupting his next move. Xu Mo frowned slightly and then looked up.
I saw a girl wearing a pink dress standing at the door of the room.
The girl's eyebrows are picturesque, her face is beautiful, her three thousand green hairs are fluttering, and there is a faint fragrance in the air. There is an emerald bell tied to each of her two jade feet, which makes a tinkling sound when she walks.
"She is..."
Looking at the beautiful girl in front of him, Xu Mo was stunned for a moment.
"Xu Mo, please give me the Holy Pill quickly. I'm anxious to go back and heal Brother Ye."
At this time, the girl said coldly, as if the Holy Pill was already in her pocket.
"Brother Ye?"
After Xu Mo heard it, he murmured, and then finally remembered the girl's identity.
The girl in front of her is named Liu Ruyan, and she is an inner disciple of Hehuan Holy Land. Her appearance can be ranked among the top three even in the huge Hehuan Holy Land.
A year ago, Xu Mo met an outer disciple Liu Ruyan while going out for training. Because of her beautiful appearance, Xu Mo, who had not yet awakened the memory of his past life, fell into a trap.
Not only did he promote her to an inner disciple, but he also handed over all the training resources given to him by the Holy Master every month to Liu Ruyan, like a big licking dog.
What makes Xu Mo feel most outrageous is that Liu Ruyan also has a childhood sweetheart named Ye Feng.
Ye Feng's meridians have been blocked since he was a child, making him unable to practice, and his health has been deteriorating.
In order to keep Ye Feng alive, Liu Ruyan came to Xu Mo every month to ask for a holy pill for Ye Feng to stabilize his condition and treat blocked veins.
And Xu Mo, who had not awakened the memory of his previous life, didn't know which muscle was wrong and actually gave Liu Ruyan the Holy Pill.
